rules.message: data-hx-encoding only affects the htmx request — the native no-JS submit needs the real enctype="multipart/form-data" attribute too.
A multipart form needs a file input (input[type=file]).
Disable the submit button during the upload (data-hx-disabled-elt).
Uploads are long — show progress: <progress class="hc-progress htmx-indicator" data-hc-upload-progress> inside the form.
